ownership_expectations.worker_targets: Worker-owned targets must be managed by Wrangler worker routes and zone DNS.
ownership_expectations.pages_targets: Pages-owned targets must be managed by Cloudflare Pages custom domains and Pages preview subdomains.

notes: Legacy route/DNS checks are synthesized from ops/cloudflare-deploy-targets.json at runtime.
Do not add new route or DNS policy entries to the legacy manifest.
